title: BPSSC Bihar Police Havildar Instructor Home Guard Admit Card 2026
postName: Havildar Instructor (From Bihar Home Guard) – Advt. No. 06/2026
vacancyDetails: Havildar Instructor posts from Bihar Home Guard cadre under Home Dept (Special)
qualification: As per BPSSC Advt 06/2026 for Havildar Instructor (Home Guard)
ageLimit: About 24–50 years as per related notices (check official advt)
applicationFee: ₹100 (as per BPSSC fee notice for related advts)
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Further stages as per BPSSC
documentsRequired: Registration number / mobile and DOB; printed e-admit card; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in (Home Guard section)
2. Open Advt 06/2026 E-Admit Card link
3. Login on apply-bpssc.com portal
4. Download hall ticket for exam on 05 Aug 2026
5. Report with original ID proof
shortDescription: BPSSC Havildar Instructor (Home Guard) Advt 06/2026 Admit Card out (around 20-21 July). Written exam on 5 August 2026.
content:
BPSSC has activated e-Admit Card download for Havildar Instructor (From Bihar Home Guard) under Advt. No. 06/2026.

Written examination is scheduled on 05 August 2026. Admit card links were published around mid/late July 2026 on the official site.

Portal: bpssc.bihar.gov.in / apply-bpssc.com
